heading: A Place to Live. A Space to Focus.
subheading: Well-structured residential living designed to cultivate discipline, peaceful study routines, and student well-being.
notice: Hostel allotments and room layouts are organized under administrative guidelines. In-person room inspections can be scheduled during campus tours.

wings.title: Boys Residential Wing
wings.description: Dedicated accommodation block for boys with structured study hours, resident faculty supervision, comfortable living spaces, and healthy dining.
keyPoints: Well-ventilated sharing rooms with personal study tables
Supervised evening and morning study study hours
Access to daily recreational and sports periods

wings.title: Girls Residential Wing
wings.description: Exclusive secure residential block for girls featuring caring female wardens, structured daily timetables, hygienic dining, and dedicated study rooms.
keyPoints: Secure residential perimeter with dedicated wardens
Quiet group study rooms and individual study corners
Nutritious, warm meal service with hygienic standards
Regular parent communication and pastoral care

facilities.title: Comfortable Living
facilities.desc: Spacious rooms with individual beds, storage wardrobes, and study desks.

facilities.title: Structured Study Hours
facilities.desc: Dedicated morning and evening self-study sessions guided by faculty.

facilities.title: Nutritious Meals
facilities.desc: Timely breakfast, lunch, evening snacks, and dinner with balanced nutrition.

facilities.title: Resident Supervision
facilities.desc: Round-the-clock warden oversight, entry tracking, and disciplined atmosphere.

facilities.title: Medical First Aid
facilities.desc: Immediate first-aid support, on-call doctor availability, and health monitoring.

facilities.title: Recreation & Rest
facilities.desc: Scheduled evening relaxation, indoor games, and weekend sports access.
